Exclusion Criteria A woman will not be eligible for this study if: - She is taking part in another study of HIV treatment during pregnancy. - Her infant has a life-threatening illness indicated in an ultrasound. - Her infant does not appear to be growing normally in the womb. - She has a cesarean section. - She has abnormal blood test results. - She has severe nausea, vomiting, or other problems of the stomach and intestines at the time of study entry. - She has an active opportunistic (AIDS-related) infection or other serious infection at the time of study entry. - The study staff cannot find a usable vein. - The study doctor feels that she cannot take drugs by mouth.
